scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:local && wrangler dev --config wrangler.local.jsonc --local --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8788
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply company-mail-local --local --config wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.bundle:check: npm run verify && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc --outdir .wrangler/deploy-check
scripts.deploy:check: npm run verify && node scripts/doctor.mjs --strict && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.production.jsonc --outdir .wrangler/deploy-check-production
scripts.deploy: npm run verify && node scripts/doctor.mjs --strict && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc
